headline: CHC @ CHW matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 3.12 at CHW 4.24, with a projected total of 7.36. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHW: CHC moved -1.95 runs while CHW moved +0.93, changing the projected margin by -2.87 runs. The projected total fell -1.02, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +10.5%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Davis Martin has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Miguel Vargas, Chase Meidroth, Alex Bregman, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Matt Shaw, Moisés Ballesteros because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
